records.description_rewritten: Jagen 90 is a meadow/forest section in Berlin's Grunewald, historically called Dahlemer Feld, with alternating grazed areas. Gay-szene.net and Planet Randy name the site. Two May 2026 source users reported visits and a possibly wrong map pin; one found the clearing difficult to locate, the other described occasional activity without saying they had a sexual encounter. Do not conflate with Jagen 87, Jagen 86, Teufelssee or the Pappelplatz cruise area.

Third general city guide references Grunewald forest, different Jagen 86 location; not Jagen 90 visitor evidence.

records.access_information: Public forest paths where permitted; sheep/grazing conservation enclosures are not access routes. May 2026 report alleges source map point inaccurate; do not reuse forum GPS without validation.

records.description_rewritten: Volkspark Humboldthain is a large public park by Gesundbrunnen. Gay-szene.net lists the Rosengarten as a historic cruising site, but its gates are reportedly closed overnight. Most recent firsthand park observation in the source on 23 October 2025 is before the cutoff and describes very limited activity, with people gathering outside the garden. Splashd carries an area name but no independent current visitor report. Historical reports of robbery/harassment demand care.

records.description_rewritten: A historical cruising entry at Treskowallee 200 points to former institutional land adjoining the Albatros school area in Karlshorst. The source listing itself says the site was sold and closed. On 29 March 2026 a first-person visitor reported both old houses and a storage hall demolished, leaving foundations. An 8 November 2025 forum report described earlier activity before closure but is not proof the site remains usable. Do not suggest entry through holes in a fence or onto private land.
